title: Home Insurance Renewal Weekly Days Until Renewal Trend
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeinsurance:renewal days_until_renewal=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_until_renewal) as avg_duration, max(days_until_renewal) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days until renewal for home insurance renewal events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_until_renewal on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days until renewal with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether home insurance renewal tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
